Original local synthetic targets only; %n demonstrates a permitted-type marker write, not arbitrary code execution.
Owned copied input assumes live stable storage during the call; ordinary fields require external serialization.
Finite logical schedules, not native-thread concurrency or external callback quiescence.
Fork private-memory observation is not complete isolation; inherited descriptors and OS policy are separate.
Work counters and fixed storage are not measured worst-case latency or resistance to an unlimited external flood.
Exact final published C17/C23 and physical observations remain separate; other T35/T36/T37 obligations not closed.
